title: Vocational Skill Development for Women

description: As part of the Dharavi Social Mission, Rotary Club of Bombay Airport undertook a vocational service initiative through the Nikayi Textile Crafts Foundation to train underprivileged women in Dharavi in hand embroidery, helping them develop skills for sustainable livelihood opportunities. An embroidery kit distribution programme was organised, with kits distributed to 50 women to support their training and encourage self-reliance through skill development. The project was attended by President AKS Harsha Mehta and Director Shashank Malviya, Director of Vocational Service.
location: Dharavi Resource Centre, Sant Kakkya Marg, Dharavi, Mumbai, Maharashtra
